name: drift-raw-final
creation_methodology: Prospective human-authored synthetic cases created and frozen before Phase III-B code or prompt experiments.
access_policy: Do not run, inspect per-case results, relabel, or tune against this dataset until individual development experiments and the combined candidate are frozen.
limitations: One engineering author; no independent annotator agreement.
